newsitem.title: INDIA: Haggar ties up with India Birla.
newsitem.headline: Haggar ties up with India Birla.

text.p: Indian textile manufacturer Birla VXL Ltd (VXL) said in a statement on Monday that it had received Indian government approval to enter into a licence agreement with Haggar Clothing Co, a unit of Haggar Corp.

The statement said test marketing had already indicated an encouraging response for the brand. It did not say when the brand would be launched in India, and company officials were not available for comment.
The statement announced VXL's financial results for 1996/97 (April-March). Net profit fell 6.23 percent to 206 million rupees in 1996/97 from 219.7 million in 1995/96.
The statement did not give the reasons for the decline.
VXL said it had also received approval from the government for a joint venture with Dormueil Freres of France, and had launched a range of suitings.
It said VXL hoped to export 30 percent of its fabric production in 1997/98, compared to 25 percent in 1995/96.
Export sales climbed to 590 million rupees in 1996/97 from 460 million in 1995/96, it said.
